board_meetings.limitations: Scheduled board-meeting dates (results announcements) as disseminated by NSE.

corporate_actions.limitations: Dividend amounts and split/bonus/consolidation factors parsed from free-text PURPOSE; factors validated against ex-date price jumps; rights issues not adjusted; demergers neutralised.

fundamentals_yahoo.limitations: SUPPLEMENTARY. ~4 annual periods (FY2023-FY2026) + ~5 quarters; latest restated values (not as-first-reported); current listings only (survivorship). Availability dates are imputed from NSE board-meeting dates or statutory deadlines.

index_levels.limitations: TRI approximated from price index + NSE published dividend yield (not official TRI). Midcap 150 / Smallcap 250 / Microcap 250 histories start when NSE began publishing them in this file.

monthly_panel.limitations: Universe limited to symbols with SHP filings (survivorship gap for delisted names).

prices_daily.limitations: Mainboard EQ/BE/BZ only. Dividends credited from parsed corporate-action text; rare unparsed purposes are missed. Delisted names keep their history until last trade.

shareholding_quarterly.limitations: Category totals per SEBI SHP format; FII = FPI cat I+II (+ foreign SWF in 2022+ taxonomy).
shareholding_quarterly.missingness: d_inst_1q missing 0.049 (first filing, gaps, IPO quarters)

shp_xbrl.limitations: Filings index only covers symbols listed in 2026 (delisted/merged companies such as HDFC, DHFL are absent: survivorship gap). XBRL exists from ~Dec-2017 only. Named holders are only those >1% (SEBI disclosure threshold).
